about: Every asset in the pixel site. 'generations' were made by PixelLab MCP tools (https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp); re-run the tool with the same args to regenerate (create_character, create_map_object, edit_image_pixen and animate_image take no seed over MCP, so a regeneration is a new variation). 'freeEdits' are pixelart_workbench edits (0 generations), replayable by tools/build_assets.py from raw/. Style: A Blueprint, mixed A3 density + A2 oak/plants/glow, picked by the owner 2026-09-27.
howToRegenerate: PIXELLAB_API_KEY=... python3 tools/regenerate.py <id> writes a fresh raw file for one generation entry; then python3 tools/build_assets.py rebuilds the atlases (free).

atlases.rats.png / rats.json: 6 tiers (intern, analyst, associate, vp, partner, frozen) x 55 frames of 68x68: rot_{s,se,e,ne,n,nw,w,sw}, idle_se, idle_ne, walk_se, walk_ne, cheer, type, slump. Animations keyed '<tier>/<anim>'.
atlases.world.png / world.json: floor_office, floor_subway, floor_hq, wall, desk_oak, desk_oak_clutter, chair, chair_dark, plant, lamp, cables, bin, papers, mug, ticker_wall (blank, pre-skewed), ticker_wall_busy, stairs, furnace, cashbag
atlases.props2.png / props2.json: built by tools/build_props2.py: the 16 sheet props and the coffee machine; kitbashes (exec_desk_gold, server_rack_white, vending_blue, sofa_navy, sofa_green, box_half, box_pile, box_pile2, filing_printer, filing_plant, crate_papers, tv_wall, tv_stand, wall_x2, wall_x3); drawn in code in the sprites' palette with the #16182c outline (box_s, box_s2, box_long, paper_stack, paper_tall, printer, sticky_wall, sticky_wall2, sticky_floor, whiteboard_wall, spill, cable_run, cable_loop). Each frame's 'source' field says which.
atlases.rats2.png / rats2.json: built by tools/build_rats2.py from the tier sheets: 5 tiers x 4 furs (grey, brown, white, black) + frozen, the 55 base frames plus sit_front, sit_back, sulk_front, sulk_back (pod desks), trimmed; accessory overlays acc/<glasses|phones_red|phones_white|hat_bowler|hat_cap|hat_beanie>/<frame>. No generations. Round 5: sit_front is a 7 frame PixelLab typing loop (raw/props6), recoloured per tier and fur; sit_back a 6 frame typing loop drawn here; kneel_0/1 (PixelLab pose + a bow); accessories redrawn bigger and acc/briefcase on walk frames.
atlases.gen.png / gen.json: drawn in code by tools/build_gen.py: floor tiles (carpet, vinyl, wood both ways, bath tile, checker, raised floor, concrete, marble, asphalt, sidewalk, driveway, lot, blueprint, grass), thin wall faces (low, tall, window, panel, garage door header), desk_back, rugs, worn spots, hazard tape. No generations. Round 4 adds the office tower storeys (base, 3 floor variants, roof), the 2x2 sky bridge pylon and the sky bridge segments.
atlases.props3.png / props3.json: built by tools/build_props3.py from the round 2 PixelLab crops (assets/raw/props3/crops): houses, shop, brick block, glass/deco/evil towers, crane, scaffold, cars, trees, street props, construction kit, vignette props, easter eggs. Round 3 adds (assets/raw/props4): townhouses, cottage, diner, corner store, office blocks, apartment tower, parking garage, warehouse, gas station, evil office, fountain, food truck, fences, alley and street props, and the cat and pigeon walk cycles. Round 4 adds (assets/raw/props5): the landmark set pieces (espresso shrine, trading pit, glass elevator, helipad and helicopter, rooftop pool and its party, rocket and launchpad, laser cannon, giant golden rat statue, vault door) and the gym and nap pod props. Round 5 adds (assets/raw/props6): rear views of the 8 cars, the Vault's 6 pile stages and the flying bill, the giant espresso machine, and the sewer (manhole lid and hole, steam vent, glowing grate, hiring tunnel, portal).
